entities.name: Annibale Maria di Francia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Annibale Maria di Francia, RCJ was an Italian Rogationist Father known for founding a series of orphanages, the Rogationists and the Daughters of Divine Zeal. He has been canonised and his feast day is 1 June.
